items.prompt: קָרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם וְלַחֹשֶׁךְ קָרָא לָיְלָה
items.answer: God called the light day, and the darkness he called night.

items.prompt: שָׁבַת אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מֵהַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
items.answer: God rested on the seventh day from the work which he had made.
The man heard the voice in the garden.
The king ruled over the people.
The boy sat in this place.

items.prompt: מָחָה יהוה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֵאָדָם וְעַד בְּהֵמָה
items.answer: Yahweh blotted out everything which he had made, man and beast.
God made the man out of dust from the ground.
He gave the sword to the king.
The boy wrote in the book.

items.prompt: God gave the woman to the man for wife.
The lion cried like an (the) ass.
God called the firmament heaven, and the dry land called he earth.
items.answer: קָרָא אֱלֹהִים לָרָקִיעַ שָׁמָיִם וְלַיַּבָּשָׁה קָרָא אָרֶץ

items.prompt: Man is dust out of the ground.
The wise people rested on the seventh day.
One called to the other and said, Yahweh is good.
items.answer: קָרָא זֶה אֶל־זֶה וְאָמַר טוֹב יְהוָה
